nodes.name: Dissolution-Precipitation and Carbonization
nodes.procedure: A necessary amount of a metal precursor was completely dissolved in 15 mL deionized water (DIW) to reach a concentration of 0.0704 M. For platinum group metals (Ru, Pd, Ir, Pt) concentrations of 0.02 M were targeted instead. A separate solution containing completely dissolved glucose (0.4 M) and hydroxylammonium chloride (4.969 M) was prepared in DIW. Subsequently, 2 mL of the glucose solution was mixed with the metal solution volume required to reach the desired precursor ratio. The mixtures were placed on a shaker operated at 170 rpm for 1 h after which the solvent was evaporated at 80 °C under reduced pressure for 16 h. Finally, the precipitated solid was carbonized in a tubular oven at 600 °C for 4 h (5 °C min−1 ramp) under N2 flow.
